fields.statement: At 2c86968ef, go test -trimpath -count=1 ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/run-start-new-main-clean passes. The script starts a --new plan run and a --new --milestone run, each through a gate step (rhiza run gate). For each run, held.sh checks that every entry of the new change set in main's .rhiza/log is byte-identical in ../repo.<slug>, is committed at the run branch's HEAD with the same bytes, and that the worktree's status is clean (prints 'held and committed: 1'). rhiza change show <cs> from main prints the title. rhiza check prints no commit-untracked or untracked-log-entry warning. rhiza health prints 'ok main on main, clean' with no orphan or untracked. go test ./internal/api -run TestNewPlanChange passes: a dry run predicts the change set ID and worktree the real run then uses. The diff of internal/api/run.go draws the entry in a dry workspace, adds the branch and worktree, then writes the same entry to the worktree and main. Attempt 1's findings f1-f3 (no commit, no health, milestone run not checked) are all addressed.
